title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 360  An Act Converting the Jalaud Barangay High School in the Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo, Into a National School, to Be Known as the Don Jose Susteguer Monfort Memorial National School.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Jalaud Barangay tại Thị trấn Barotac Nuevo, Tỉnh Iloilo thành Trường Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Tưởng niệm Don Jose Susteguer Monfort Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jalaud Barangay ในเทศบาล Barotac Nuevo จังหวัด Iloilo เป็น โรงเรียนแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Don Jose Susteguer Monfort แห่งชาติ

text.en:
The Jalaud Barangay High School in the Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo, is
hereby converted into a national school, to be known as the Don Jose Susteguer Monfort Memorial National

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports shall take the necessary steps for the immediate
implementation of this Act.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of
Education, Culture and Sports intended for new national high schools: Provided, That the local government
unit concerned shall continue to provide funding for its share in the cost of maintenance and operation of the
school. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the
annual General Appropriations Act.
Approved: March 31, 1983
